title: Local sessions stop failing on the GitHub plugin's empty token
why: A mailaudit session's finding, Oct 26: the GitHub plugin sends 'Bearer ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}' with the variable unset, so GitHub's MCP server refuses it on every local session.
note: Deferred (shiv, Oct 26): your pick. Asked: waiting page item c87-github-plugin (triage, Oct 27). (a) Turn the plugin off: gh covers every PR step, so nothing is lost (coordinator's and the session's pick). (b) Set the token: you get the MCP tools, plus one more token to rotate. Checked claude-settings main 54be9f1: its enabledPlugins does not list a GitHub plugin, so it is switched on outside the managed settings; where is unknown until a local session looks. The fix should land in claude-settings so every machine gets it. Port: no; global settings install everywhere. Placed ahead of c54, after c47 (triage, Oct 26): both are local setup on your machines.
